title: How to Build Self-Confidence: What Research Supports (and Which Popular Tips Don't Hold Up)
seoTitle: How to Build Self-Confidence: What Research Supports
seoDescription: Build self-confidence with small wins, relatable role models, specific feedback and reframed nerves, and see what research says on power poses.
excerpt: A research-backed guide to confidence: Bandura's four sources of self-efficacy, a table of popular tips versus the evidence, and practical steps for group discussions, vivas, first jobs and speaking English at work.
